title: Notes on Live Streaming (2): How to Turn Human Attention into Big Business
summary: Part 2 looks at the human beings on both sides of the screen: why sharp big spenders pay for live human attention and care, and how scaling something inherently exclusive pushes streamers toward staged rivalries, WeChat access, emotional calluses, 2D avatars, and male ghost-chatters.
